body:
## Goal

Sketch a small implementation for the discussion in #257: meta-orchestrated work should not always self-approve and self-merge each child PR immediately when the child review returns `SHIP`.

## Context

Current behavior is per-PR: `implement` hands off to `review`, `SHIP` hands off to `agent-self-approve`, and approval can then hand off to `agent-self-merge`. This is reasonable for independent child PRs, but risky for one logical meta task split into stacked or dependent PRs.

The requested direction is to introduce an explicit meta-orchestration policy so batch/stacked child PRs can stop after review readiness and let the parent orchestrator finalize them later, in dependency order.

Relevant areas mentioned in the discussion:
- `.github/prompts/agent-orchestrator.md`
- `.agent/src/handoff.ts`
- `.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts`
- `.agent/src/sub-orchestration.ts`

## Acceptance Criteria

- Preserve current per-PR self-approval/self-merge behavior for ordinary and independent PR flows.
- Add a small, explicit mechanism for batch/stacked orchestrated child work to defer `agent-self-approve` / `agent-self-merge` after `review` returns `SHIP`.
- When deferral applies, the child result should report a ready-for-parent/finalization state instead of launching self-approval immediately.
- Parent/meta orchestrator guidance should describe that deferred PRs are finalized after no more child work remains, in the correct dependency order.
- Include focused tests or fixtures covering both independent immediate self-approval and deferred batch/stacked behavior.

## Ambiguity

The discussion proposes marking child work as `independent` vs `batch/stacked`, but does not prescribe the exact representation. The implementation should choose the smallest repo-consistent signal or metadata shape that supports this policy without a broad orchestration redesign.

---

Requested via discussion_comment at https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/discussions/257

comments.body:
**Sepo implementation finished**

- Branch: `agent/implement-issue-259/codex-25977703817`
- Pull request: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/260

Added an explicit sub-orchestrator finalization policy so batch/stacked child work can mark `finalize_policy: "defer"`; trusted deferred child PRs now stop after review `SHIP` and report readiness to the parent instead of dispatching self-approval, while ordinary PRs keep the existing immediate self-approval/self-merge path. Verified with `npm run build`, focused handoff/sub-orchestration/orchestrate-handoff tests, and `git diff --check`.
Closing because this agent issue has had no activity for 30 days.

title: Defer self-merge for batch orchestrator PRs
